channel.title: Digital Trends – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Digital Trends – Bias and Credibility (digitaltrends.com)

item.title: Claude can now autonomously handle chores on your PC without any fussy OpenClaw setup
item.description: Claude can now use your computer on your behalf, clicking, scrolling, and navigating apps to complete tasks while you focus on other things. No complicated setup required.

item.title: Oura Ring 5 leak gives you an early look at its biggest changes
item.description: An early Oura Ring 5 leak reveals a refined design, new Deep Rose color, and improved sensors, giving a preview of what to expect ahead of its expected late 2027 release.

item.title: Gemini avatar lets you appear in AI content without filming yourself
item.description: Google may soon let you create a reusable 3D avatar inside Gemini, allowing you to insert yourself into AI-generated images and videos without constant selfies, signaling a shift toward faster and more consistent content creation.

item.title: TCL X11L Review: A pleasing blend of display excellence and surprisingly great audio
item.description: If you are in the market for a large, premium television and you want the best picture quality that Mini-LED can currently offer, then the TCL X11L deserves serious consideration

item.title: Ultrahuman Ring PRO is back in the US, and it makes every other smart ring look overpriced
item.description: Ultrahuman Ring PRO is back in the US with 45-day battery life, no mandatory subscription, and early bird pricing starting at $349.

item.title: Playing with AI: My Sweet 16 is still pretty sweet
item.description: (NOTE: This article is part of an ongoing series documenting an experiment with using AI to fill the NCAA brackets and see how it fares against years of human experience. item.title: I see Galaxy S26’s AirDrop support as progress, but I just don’t think it changes much
item.description: Samsung supporting AirDrop the Galaxy S26 is the kind of upgrade people will appreciate instantly and buy a phone for almost never.

item.title: Spotify wants you to explore music like never before with SongDNA
item.description: Spotify has launched SongDNA in beta, a feature that maps connections between songs, artists, and samples for deeper music discovery.

item.title: Galaxy Z Fold 8 renders hint at Samsung fixing one big Fold 7 mistake
item.description: Samsung isn't reinventing the wheel with the Galaxy Z Fold 8, but it is making it spin faster — with a 5,000mAh battery, 45W charging, and a 50MP ultrawide finally joining the party.

item.title: My life turned into a subscription trap, but I axed the bad bills with these tricks
